📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`
This is occurrence #204. 24h notification gate reopened (last notified: 2026-06-24T15:28Z → gate opened 15:28Z today).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Vertical App Experience` (`@vertical-app-experience` / `#team-vae`)
Playbook: Confirm p95 metric; confirm latency-only (0 error logs); profile slow accounts in DD APM traces link; track until p95 drops below 3s for ≥15 min.
Open Jira: n/a

Source alerts (1 total — DD APM-sourced, degraded cycle, no Slack MCP):
  • https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/115456700 — RTC Screen Load P95 recurring pattern

Evidence:
  • DD APM metric: p95:trace.aspnet_core.request{env:prod,service:runtime-core-api,resource_name:post_/api/v1/runtime/load/_screenid*} — 17 pts ≥3.0s in 15:02–16:07Z (of 195 total, 8.7%), peak 5.95s at 15:45Z
  • Spike clusters: 15:14–15:15Z (4pts max 4.71s), 15:22Z (3.85s), 15:30Z (2pts), 15:37Z (5.09s), 15:45Z (peak 5.95s), 15:48–15:52Z (4pts), 16:00Z (3.91s), 16:07Z (4.71s)
  • Latency-only confirmed: DD Logs service:runtime-core-api status:error env:prod → 0 hits in window
  • DD APM traces (>3s): https://app.datadoghq.com/apm/traces?query=service%3Aruntime-core-api%20%40duration%3A%3E3s&start=1782399760000&end=1782403660000
  • DD metric explorer: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.aspnet_core.request&exp_scope=env%3Aprod%2Cservice%3Aruntime-core-api&exp_agg=p95&start=1782399760&end=1782403660
  • Kibana: 0 hits in window (not the evidence datasource for this KB — latency-only, DD APM sourced)

Root-cause analysis:
  Query: p95:trace.aspnet_core.request{env:prod,service:runtime-core-api,resource_name:post_/api/v1/runtime/load/_screenid*}, 15:02–16:07Z
  Observed: 17 pts ≥3.0s, peak 5.95s at 15:45Z; prev window peak was 12.14s at 14:40Z (improving trend)
  Reasoning: Recurring P95 latency pattern on RTC Screen Load endpoint; latency-only (0 error logs); magnitude declining (12.14s→5.95s peak).

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-28-mobile-asyncstorage-securestore-keychain`
This is occurrence #10. Resurfacing at every-10th-occurrence gate (last notified: 2026-06-24T18:27Z).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Service Delivery` (`@service-delivery` / `#team-service-delivery`)
Playbook: Client-side iOS keychain migration failure; relay via mobilenative.method.me; server-side no action. Route to mobile team for AsyncStorage→SecureStore migration fix (app v2.1.651). Monitor for volume decay.
Open Jira: n/a

Source alerts (1 total — ES-sourced, degraded cycle, no Slack MCP):
  • https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/227951254 — New issue to review (ERR_KEY_CHAIN catch-all)

Evidence:
  • ES aggregate: Error:"ERR_KEY_CHAIN" OR message:"ERR_KEY_CHAIN", 15:02–16:07Z → 2,706 hits, 100% service=nonprod/apps
  • Rate trend: ~124/min (2026-06-24 ~17:00Z) → ~59/min (14:03–15:08Z today) → ~42/min (this window) — DECELERATING
  • DD Logs evidence_query returned 0 in this window (actual data in ES via server relay, not DD Logs pipeline)
  • Kibana (ERR_KEY_CHAIN): https://logstash.method.me/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:2026-06-25T15:02:00Z,to:2026-06-25T16:07:00Z))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:ERR_KEY_CHAIN))

Root-cause analysis:
  Query: ES Error:"ERR_KEY_CHAIN" OR message:"ERR_KEY_CHAIN" → field:fields.dd_service.keyword, 15:02–16:07Z
  Observed: 2,706 hits, all nonprod/apps (iOS client errors relayed server-side); rate ~42/min
  Rate trend (3 cycles): 124/min → 59/min → 42/min — consistent deceleration
  Reasoning: Ongoing iOS keychain migration storm, occurrence #10, triggering 10th-occurrence resurface notification. Storm is decelerating; mobile team should be routing to fix the AsyncStorage→SecureStore migration or wrap in try/catch.
